title: What Are They Filtering Out? An Experimental Benchmark of Filtering Strategies for Harm Reduction in Pretraining Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying mentions of named entities categorized by gender using a custom knowledge base (People Dataset), and measuring the percentage of these mentions that are removed from Common Crawl samples when applying various pretraining data filtering strategies (rule-based, classifier-based, and quality-based).

Linking named entities in text samples to a knowledge base categorized by origin (Western vs. Post-colonial minorities) and calculating the disproportionate removal rates of these groups' mentions across different harm-reduction data filtering strategies.
